stop_reached: Delivery: run turn 4 composed one board (section 1:3) in the pinned file after the gate's yes, and replied with the board URL, Read-back, Left out, two Finding lines and the HVR self-scan
reason: On signals alone the flow landed in the pinned FigJam file with self-measured counts matching the model (7 of 7 nodes, 6 of 6 connectors) and no destructive verb, and nothing was written before the gate's yes. The fj fallback the scenario targets was never exercised because the driver kept the hosted MCP live and never ran the operator steps, so fj info and fj nodes -l are harness. A grader may prefer SKIP for that reason. Minor note: turn-4.md says the exit labels were confirmed 'from its screenshot' but no get_screenshot call was made, only the use_figma result and get_figjam.
